# Issues and community {#community}

## Having trouble {-}

If something is broken or you are stuck, the best thing you can do is **open an issue on the GitHub repository of the relevant component**:

* Firmware, QC, scheduling, the REST API --- [DWARPH-firmware](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-firmware/issues)
* The desktop dashboard, discovery, MQTT --- [DWARPH-commander](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-commander/issues)
* Image analysis, segmentation, the released model, workers --- [DWARPH-CV](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-CV/issues)
* The hub: projects, the viewer, sync --- [DWARPH-hub](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-hub/issues)
* PCBs and printed parts --- [DWARPH-hardware](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPH-hardware/issues)
* This documentation --- [DWARPHs.github.io](https://github.com/DWARPHs/DWARPHs.github.io/issues)

An issue is more useful than an email: it is searchable, and the next person with the same problem finds the answer.

When reporting a device problem, it helps a great deal to include the firmware version, the device's `schedule.json` (with Wi-Fi credentials removed), and the relevant part of the serial monitor or the Commander's `Debug` log.

## Contributing {-}

External contributions are welcome. There are several ways to help:

* Requesting features and reporting bugs through the GitHub issue tracker
* Sending pull requests to any of the existing repositories
* Improving this documentation --- every page has an **Edit** link in the top bar that takes you straight to its source
* Volunteering to maintain or develop a component
